headline: Braddock Upsets Baer to Claim Heavyweight Championship of the World
dispatch: James J. Braddock, a heavy underdog who had spent recent years on relief, dethroned champion Max Baer by unanimous decision at the Madison Square Garden Bowl in Long Island City on Thursday night. Braddock, known as the Cinderella Man, absorbed Baer's power through fifteen rounds and outpointed him with steady, precise work. The outcome stunned boxing experts who had installed Baer as a ten-to-one favorite before the opening bell.
answer: Underdog Braddock shocks Baer to win heavyweight crown, 1935
